capabilities: Create alternate versions of selected text passages
Preview versions inline via hover or a command
Commit a previewed version to the note by double-clicking
Edit existing versions and save edits to the active version
Customize underline, highlight, and notice colors in settings
disambiguation: Not file-level version control like git; it versions selected text passages within a single note, not whole files.
extras: README warns to back up the vault and test in a separate vault first, and notes that inactive versions exist only in the plugin's data.json, which should be included in backups.
motivation: The README says it was 'primarily created for writers to be able to write and compare alternate versions of selected passages'.
problem: Writers must duplicate notes or files to keep and compare alternate versions of a passage; this keeps all variants in one note.
summary: Writer-focused tool that creates, previews, and commits alternate versions of selected text passages inside a note, storing inactive versions in its data file.
